title: Double Burger
description: A classic double burger recipe with two juicy patties, cheese, and all the fixings.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the double burger patties with double meat seasoning.
3. Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 160°F.
4. Meanwhile, toast the burger buns on the grill.
5. Assemble the burgers by spreading a slice of cheese on the bottom bun, followed by a patty, a few strips of fried chicken, a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, and finally the top bun.
